wa_narrow_arrow_overhang.notes: SCOPE: own line (MP, guide, theCrag). theCrag also lists 'NAO first anchor' (5.11d, 82 ft) as a separate entry for the first part of the pitch to the lowest chains. Sits between Natural Log Cabin / Deal with it Ranger and Narrow Arrow Direct. FA DEFECT (report only): fa stores the aid FA, two partial FFAs and their labels in one string; MP adds the first complete free ascent of the modern pitch by Ben Gilkison, October 2008. Not rewritten (batch N rule). SAFETY (report, prose not rewritten): (1) MP comment 2022-09-07 says the LOWEST anchor has disappeared and the current lowest anchor is at the top of the 'cryptic 5.11R' section. Stored pitch_detail[0].belay reads "The belay is an anchor on a ledge, reached after the face and corner moves past two bolts." and gear item reads "2 bolts on the first pitch, to a ledge anchor"; the owner should check whether that ledge anchor is the one now gone. (2) MP comment 2017-09-01: the 0.5 Camalot placement that protected the roof crux pulled and took a large chunk of rock with it; the placement is now shallow and unreliable (a blue Totem near the lip is suggested, finicky). The MP page also notes broken rock changed a critical placement. Stored pitch_detail[1].notes lists 'cams to 1 in' for the crux pitch without this warning. Descent per MP: single 70 m rope from the top anchors. No 2023-rockfall change reported.

wa_full_horse_power.notes: SCOPE / CLEAN-UP CANDIDATE: an EXTENSION, not its own line. MP's Powerhorse page describes Full Horse Power as the extension that continues out over the roof above Powerhorse's anchor. Powerhorse (catalog wa_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow_powerhorse; MP 5.13a, 90 ft, FA Justen Sjong; guide 5.12d) climbs Iron Horse (wa_iron_horse) to its first chains, then Amandla's (wa_amandla) upper arete bolts. MP's Amandla page says the original Amandla anchor was moved up under the roof, and its own extension goes over the roof past one bolt to a ledge anchor. So Full Horse Power = Iron Horse start + Amandla upper arete + the roof extension: related to BOTH Powerhorse (its full version) and Iron Horse (its start). Not in the Index guide's list, not on theCrag's sector, no MP page: only OpenBeta lists it, with no description. Owner decides whether it stays. MISFILED: OpenBeta files it in 'Main Wall, left side', which is OpenBeta's name for MP's 'Dwarf Tossing to Narrow Arrow' (OpenBeta's list of 48 there is MP's list of 46 plus Full Horse Power and Open Project). If kept, it belongs in wa_dwarf_tossing_to_narrow_arrow beside Powerhorse. No 2023-rockfall change reported.
